purpose: Bind exact VexLife owner evidence to the accepted Vextreme-SDK VS-FND request and consume its no-effect receipt as a recommendation-only VexLife route receipt without becoming a second Stewardship owner, scheduler, concern lifecycle, authority owner, or executor.
consumedOwnerEvidence: Intent Workgraph root intent and current work-node identity
Intent Scheduler current ACTIVE occupancy identity
Intent Scheduler current ACTIVE capability-lease binding
Intent Scheduler current ACTIVE effect-lease binding
source-bound Stewardship path, continuity, timing, authority and outcome projections supplied by their rightful owners
adapterV1Rules: request root intent must equal the exact VexLife graph root intent
accepted assignment must be CURRENT and remain NO_AUTHORITY plus NO_EFFECTS
accepted assignment assignee must equal the adapter-v1 current occupancy actor
work node, assignment, occupancy, capability lease and effect lease must bind one exact graph/work lineage
occupancy and both leases must be CURRENT and ACTIVE
capability and effect leases must bind the exact work-node envelopes
the canonical VexLife capability-envelope ref is the opaque VS-FND capability binding identity for adapter v1
adapter v1 requires one current occupancy and does not claim alternate-occupancy sourcing semantics
the SDK request remains exact and receives no adapter-only fields
the SDK receipt must bind exact caseRef, profileRef, request sourceRefs and a valid SDK receipt fingerprint
every SDK effect flag must remain false
a returned transition is a recommendation-only route projection and grants no execution or effect authority
